insights.text: A founder should recognize warning signs and cut losses before commitment to a failing business turns into denial; Kiran applies this lesson to Kingfisher Airlines.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

insights.text: Biocon moved from enzymes into biopharmaceuticals by reusing its fermentation capabilities for higher-value products.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

insights.text: An IPO gave Biocon valued stock that could be monetized or used in acquisitions, beyond the cash raised at listing.

insights.text: Unilever's ownership taught Biocon global manufacturing, reporting, regulatory and intellectual-property practices.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

insights.text: Biocon sold its enzyme business when future investment would favor biopharmaceuticals, allowing a specialist buyer to develop the older business.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

insights.text: Building biosimilars over a long period let Biocon absorb costs that would sharply affect an established pharmaceutical firm's current earnings if it entered now.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

insights.text: India needs more research spending and curiosity-driven education to turn its young population into innovation capacity.
insights.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

stories.text: In 1978, Les Hawkins tracked Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw down in Baroda before her train to Delhi and persuaded her to start an Indian enzyme venture instead of taking a brewing job in Scotland.
stories.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
stories.lesson: A credible partner can open an entrepreneurial path when conventional employers refuse one.

stories.text: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw told Vijay Mallya to downsize Kingfisher Airlines during its crisis, but he continued trying to fund a larger airline as losses and debt grew.
stories.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
stories.lesson: Act on early signs of failure rather than financing escalating losses.

stories.text: John sold his Chelsea townhouse investment and helped raise two million dollars so he and Kiran could buy Unilever's 30 percent stake in Biocon.
stories.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
stories.lesson: A contractual preemptive right enabled the founders to regain ownership.
